announce_volume.label: Volume for Announcements
announce_volume.description: The percentual, relative or absolute volume level, used with the strategy for announcements.

announce_volume_max.label: Maximum Volume level for Announcements
announce_volume_max.description: The volume (adjustment) of announcements should not go above this level.

announce_volume_min.label: Minimum Volume level for Announcements
announce_volume_min.description: The volume (adjustment) of announcements should not go below this level.

announce_volume_strategy.label: Volume strategy for Announcements
announce_volume_strategy.description: When an announcement is being broadcast to this player, how should the volume be adjusted temporarily (use in combination with the volume value below)?

auto_play.label: Automatically play (resume on power on)
auto_play.description: When this player is turned ON, automatically start playing (if there are items in the queue).

crossfade_different_sample_rates.label: Allow crossfades between tracks of different sample rates
crossfade_different_sample_rates.description:
Enable this option to allow crossfades between tracks that have different sample rates (e.g. 44.1kHz to 48kHz). 

 Disable this option if you experience audio glitches during transitions between tracks.

crossfade_duration.label: Crossfade duration
crossfade_duration.description: Duration in seconds of the crossfade between tracks (if enabled)

enable_icy_metadata.label: Try to inject metadata into stream (ICY)
enable_icy_metadata.description:
Try to inject metadata into the stream (ICY) to show track info on the player, even when flow mode is enabled.

This is called ICY metadata and is what is used by online radio stations to show you what is playing. 

Be aware that not all players support this correctly. If you experience issues with playback, try disabling this setting.

options.disabled: Disabled - do not send ICY metadata

flow_mode.label: Enable queue flow mode
flow_mode.description:
Enable "flow" mode where all queue tracks are sent as a continuous audio stream.
Use for players that do not natively support gapless and/or crossfading or if the player has trouble transitioning between tracks.

flow_mode_sample_rate.label: Flow Mode sample rate
flow_mode_sample_rate.description:
When streaming in Flow Mode, the entire queue is sent as one gapless stream and must use a single sample rate for the whole stream.

- 'Smart (upsample only)': Starts the flow stream at the sample rate of the first track. Subsequent tracks with an equal or lower sample rate are upsampled to match; if the next track has a higher sample rate, the flow stream is restarted at that higher rate. This is the best balance between quality and seamless playback.
- 'Bit-perfect (no resampling)': Never resamples audio (unless the player does not support the track's sample rate). Playback is restarted between queue tracks when their sample rates differ, which disables gapless and crossfade between those tracks.
- '48 kHz': Resamples all audio to a fixed 48 kHz (or the closest rate supported by the player) using a high quality resampler. A good compromise of quality and bandwidth.
- '96 kHz': Resamples all audio to a fixed 96 kHz (or the closest rate supported by the player) using a high quality resampler.
- 'Highest supported by player': Resamples all audio to the highest sample rate the player supports. Note that this can waste a lot of bandwidth.

http_profile.label: HTTP Profile used for sending audio
http_profile.description: This is considered to be a very advanced setting, only adjust this if needed, for example if your player stops playing halfway streams or if you experience other playback related issues. In most cases the default setting is fine.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description:
Material design icon for this player.

See https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/.

library_sync_album_tracks.label: Import album tracks
library_sync_album_tracks.description:
By default, when importing Albums into the library, only the Album itself will be imported into the Music Assistant Library, allowing you to manually browse and select which tracks you want to import. 

If you want to override this default behavior, you can use this configuration option.

Please note that some (streaming) sources may already define this behavior unsolicited, by automatically adding all tracks from the album to their library/favorites.

library_sync_albums.label: Sync Library Albums from this source to Music Assistant
library_sync_albums.description:
Whether to import (favourited/in-library) Albums from this source to the Music Assistant Library. 

Please note that by adding an Album into the Music Assistant library, the Album Artists will always be imported as well.

library_sync_artists.label: Sync Library Artists from this source to Music Assistant
library_sync_artists.description: Whether to synchronize (favourited/in-library) Artists from this source to the Music Assistant Library.

library_sync_audiobooks.label: Sync Library Audiobooks from this source to Music Assistant
library_sync_audiobooks.description: Whether to import (favourited/in-library) Audiobooks from this source to the Music Assistant Library.

library_sync_back.label: Sync back library additions/removals (2-way sync)
library_sync_back.description:
Specify the behavior if an item is manually added to (or removed from) the Music Assistant Library. 
Should we synchronise that action back to the source?

Please note that if you you don't sync back to the source and you have enabled automatic sync/import for this source, a removed item may reappear in the library the next time a sync is performed.

library_sync_deletions.label: Sync library deletions
library_sync_deletions.description:
When enabled, items removed from the source's library will also be hidden from the Music Assistant library.

When disabled, items removed from the source will remain visible in the Music Assistant library.

library_sync_playlist_tracks.label: Import playlist tracks
library_sync_playlist_tracks.description:
By default, when importing Playlists into the library, only the Playlist itself will be imported into the Music Assistant Library, allowing you to browse and play the Playlist and optionally add any individual tracks of the Playlist to the Music Assistant Library manually. 

Use this configuration option to override this default behavior, by specifying the Playlists for which you'd like to import all tracks.
You can either enter the Playlist name (case sensitive) or the Playlist URI.

library_sync_playlists.label: Sync Library Playlists from this source to Music Assistant
library_sync_playlists.description: Whether to import (favourited/in-library) Playlists from this source to the Music Assistant Library.

library_sync_podcasts.label: Sync Library Podcasts from this source to Music Assistant
library_sync_podcasts.description: Whether to import (favourited/in-library) Podcasts from this source to the Music Assistant Library.

library_sync_radios.label: Sync Library Radios from this source to Music Assistant
library_sync_radios.description: Whether to import (favourited/in-library) Radio stations from this source to the Music Assistant Library.

library_sync_tracks.label: Sync Library Tracks from this source to Music Assistant
library_sync_tracks.description:
Whether to import (favourited/in-library) Tracks from this source to the Music Assistant Library. 

Please note that by adding a Track into the Music Assistant library, the Track's Artists and Album will always be imported as well.

log_level.label: Log level
log_level.description: Set the log verbosity for this provider.

manual_discovery_ip_addresses.label: Manual IP addresses for discovery
manual_discovery_ip_addresses.description:
In normal circumstances, Music Assistant will automatically discover all players on the network. using multicast discovery on the (L2) local network, such as mDNS or UPNP.

In case of special network setups or when you run into issues where one or more players are not discovered, you can manually add the IP addresses of the players here. 

Note that this setting is not recommended for normal use and should only be used if you know what you are doing. Also, if players are not on the same subnet asthe Music Assistant server, you may run into issues with streaming. In that case always ensure that the players can reach the server on the network and double check the base URL configuration of the Stream server in the settings.

max_volume.label: Maximum volume
max_volume.description: Maximum device volume. The volume slider (0-100) will be scaled to this as the upper bound.

min_volume.label: Minimum volume
min_volume.description: Minimum device volume. The volume slider (0-100) will be scaled to this as the lower bound.

output_channels.label: Output Channel Mode
output_channels.description: You can configure this player to play only the left or right channel, for example to create a stereo pair with 2 players.

output_codec.label: Output codec to use for streaming audio to the player
output_codec.description:
Select the codec to use for streaming audio to this player. 
By default, Music Assistant sends lossless, high quality audio to all players and prefers the FLAC codec because it offers some compression while still remaining lossless 

Some players however do not support FLAC and require the stream to be packed into e.g. a lossy mp3 codec or you like to save some network bandwidth. 

 Choosing a lossy codec saves some bandwidth at the cost of audio quality.

output_limiter.label: Enable limiting to prevent clipping
output_limiter.description: Activates a limiter that prevents audio distortion by making loud peaks quieter.

play_media_overrides_group.label: Play Media overrides active group
play_media_overrides_group.description: When this player is currently captured by an active group or sync session, an explicit Play Media command (e.g. starting a new playlist or track from Home Assistant) will release this player from the group/sync and play the new media directly on this player. Disable this to keep the legacy behavior where Play Media is redirected to the group leader. Other commands (next/prev/pause/resume) are always forwarded to the group leader as they act on the existing playback.

preview_note.label:
Please note that this feature/provider is still in early stages. 

Functionality may still be limited and/or bugs may occur!

sample_rates.label: Sample rates supported by this player
sample_rates.description:
The sample rates (and bit depths) supported by this player.
Content with unsupported sample rates will be automatically resampled.

smart_fades_mode.label: Enable Smart Fades
smart_fades_mode.description:
Select the crossfade mode to use when transitioning between tracks.

- 'Smart Crossfade': Uses beat matching and EQ filters to create smooth transitions between tracks.
- 'Standard Crossfade': Regular crossfade that crossfades the last/first x-seconds of a track.

sync_adjust.label: Audio synchronization delay correction
sync_adjust.description: If this player is playing audio synced with other players and you always hear the audio too early or late on this player, you can shift the audio a bit.

tts_pre_announce.label: Pre-announce TTS announcements
tts_pre_announce.description: When a TTS (text-to-speech) message is sent to the Announce feature, prepend the announcement with a short pre-announcement sound (bell whistle).

unofficial_provider_note.label: This is an unofficial integration that is not affiliated with, supported by, or endorsed by the music service. It relies on interfaces that are not officially supported and may stop working at any time. Use of this provider may also be subject to the service's terms of use.

volume_normalization.label: Enable volume normalization (EBU-R128 based)
volume_normalization.description: Enable volume normalization based on the EBU-R128 standard without affecting dynamic range

volume_normalization_target.label: Target level for volume normalization
volume_normalization_target.description:
Adjust average (perceived) loudness to this target level, default is -17 LUFS

**WARNING:** Setting the level too high may result in clipping!

zeroconf_interfaces.label: Mdns/Zeroconf discovery interface(s)
zeroconf_interfaces.description:
In normal circumstances, Music Assistant will automatically discover all players on the network using multicast discovery on the (L2) local network, such as mDNS or UPNP.

By default, Music Assistant will only listen on the default interface. If you have multiple network interfaces and you want to discover players on all interfaces, you can change this setting to 'All interfaces'.

protocol_enable.label: Enable
protocol_enable.description: Enable or disable this output protocol for the player.

pre_announcement_chime_url.label: Custom (pre)announcement chime URL
pre_announcement_chime_url.description:
URL to a custom audio file to play before announcements.
Leave empty to use the default chime.
Supports http:// and https:// URLs pointing to audio files (.mp3, .wav, .flac, .ogg, .m4a, .aac).
Example: http://homeassistant.local:8123/local/audio/custom_chime.mp3

hide_in_ui.label: Hide this player in the user interface
hide_in_ui.description: Hide this player from the main players list and dashboard selection menus.  The player remains fully controllable and still appears in any sync group it currently belongs to and in the settings. Disable the player to exclude it everywhere.

expose_player_to_ha.label: Expose this player to Home Assistant
expose_player_to_ha.description:
Expose this player to the Home Assistant integration. 
If disabled, this player will not be imported into Home Assistant.

preferred_output_protocol.label: Preferred Output Protocol
preferred_output_protocol.description: Select the preferred protocol for audio playback to this device.

smart_crossfade_unavailable.label: Smart Crossfade is unavailable because this system has limited memory. It requires more RAM than is currently available for audio buffering.

default_enqueue_select_artist.label: Items to select when you play a (in-library) artist.

options.library_tracks: In-library tracks for the artist only
options.prefer_library: Prefer library, fall back to top

default_enqueue_select_album.label: Items to select when you play a (in-library) album.

options.all_tracks: All tracks for album on (streaming) provider

default_enqueue_option_artist.label: Default enqueue option for Artist item(s).
default_enqueue_option_artist.description: Define the default enqueue action for this mediatype.

default_enqueue_option_album.label: Default enqueue option for Album item(s).
default_enqueue_option_album.description: Define the default enqueue action for this mediatype.

default_enqueue_option_track.label: Default enqueue option for Track item(s).
default_enqueue_option_track.description: Define the default enqueue action for this mediatype.

default_enqueue_option_genre.label: Default enqueue option for Genre item(s).
default_enqueue_option_genre.description: Define the default enqueue action for this mediatype.

default_enqueue_option_live_sources.label: Default enqueue option for Radio and Live Input item(s).
default_enqueue_option_live_sources.description: Default enqueue action for live, infinite streams — radio stations and plugin AudioSources (Spotify Connect, AirPlay receiver, etc.).

default_enqueue_option_playlist.label: Default enqueue option for Playlist item(s).
default_enqueue_option_playlist.description: Define the default enqueue action for this mediatype.

default_enqueue_option_audiobook.label: Default enqueue option for Audiobook item(s).

default_enqueue_option_podcast.label: Default enqueue option for Podcast item(s).

default_enqueue_option_podcast_episode.label: Default enqueue option for Podcast-episode item(s).

default_enqueue_option_folder.label: Default enqueue option for Folder item(s).

volume_normalization_radio.label: Volume normalization method for radio streams

volume_normalization_fixed_gain_radio.label: Fixed/fallback gain adjustment for radio streams

publish_ip.label: Published IP address
publish_ip.description:
This IP address is communicated to players where to find this server.
Make sure that this IP can be reached by players on the local network, otherwise audio streaming will not work.

bind_port.label: TCP Port
bind_port.description: The TCP port to run the server. Make sure that this server can be reached on the given IP and TCP port by players on the local network.

bind_ip.label: Bind to IP/interface
bind_ip.description:
Start the stream server on this specific interface. 
Use 0.0.0.0 to bind to all interfaces (both IPv4 and IPv6), which is the default. 
This is an advanced setting that should normally not be adjusted in regular setups.

background_scan_concurrency.label: Background analysis concurrency
background_scan_concurrency.description: Maximum number of tracks analyzed concurrently during the nightly background scan. Default 1 (serial). Increase only if your hardware can handle concurrent torch/ffmpeg work.

reset_db.label: Reset library database
reset_db.description: This will issue a full reset of the library database and trigger a full sync. Only use this option as a last resort if you are seeing issues with the library database.

recently_played.name: Recently played
recently_played.subtitle: Pick up where you left off
